thread:
Sam: Quick postmortem follow-up 1: we need to lock down customer comms (status page + 72h) and confirm RCA sharing policy. Who's in for drafting?
Ivy: I can take the 72-hour redacted summary. Will keep it customer-friendly and include a short "what were doing" list.
Cole: I'll handle the statuspage snippet and the short FAQ blurb explaining redactions.
Sam: Should we adopt the redacted-public + full-on-request approach or be more open? Legal input wanted.
Legal: Leaning redacted public RCA + full RCA available to verified affected customers under existing confidentiality terms. We will provide a redaction checklist.
Marina: OK. For the 72h summary, include timeline + user impact + immediate mitigations + next steps (owners + ETA). Keep it <300 words.
Ivy: Draft timeline: detection 02:08 UTC, mitigation started 02:20 UTC, traffic reroute complete 02:55 UTC. Impact window ~02:08-02:50 UTC. No customer data access detected.
Cole: Statuspage draft (2 lines):
```
Status: Service disruption affecting inference API (us-west-2).
Impact: Elevated latency and errors for a subset of requests between 02:0802:50 UTC. Current status: Most customers restored; validation ongoing. A redacted summary will be posted within 72 hours.
```
Ethan: Suggest we avoid absolute words like "most" unless verified. Maybe "service restored for the majority of customers"?
Cole: Updated.
Sam: Action items + owners (add to postmortem doc PRD-5003):
- Ivy: 72h redacted summary (draft T+36h, final T+70h)
- Cole: statuspage snippet + FAQ line (due T+12h)
- Legal: redaction checklist + review (within 24h of draft)
- Marina: enterprise outreach & eligibility list (due T+24h)
- Ethan: recurrence analysis across last 90 days (ticket PRD-5004, due T+7d)
CS-Lead: We'll prepare customer outreach templates and hold on send until Legal signs off.
Ivy: Proposed 72h sentence offering full RCA: "Full RCA is available to affected customers under existing confidentiality terms; contact support to request."
Legal: Approved. Add a line about eligibility verification process.
Marina: We'll maintain a short log of which accounts requested the RCA and which received it. Keep internal link in postmortem doc.
Ethan: For recurrence analysis I'll attach the query and dashboard links to PRD-5004. Recommend adding an alert rule to catch slow-tail latency >P95 over baseline for 3+ days.
Sam: Good. Also let's standardize statuspage templates so the wording doesn't get re-litigated. Cole/Ivy, can you put a single-line template in /playbooks/status-templates/status-one-liner.md?
Cole: Will do and include examples for "mitigated" vs "restored" wording.
OpsBot: @Cole Statuspage update queued. Publish window: 25 minutes.
CS-Lead: Email template ready; will include link to status.redwood.ai and CTA to request full RCA.
Ivy: Draft 72h paragraph ready, posting to PRD-5003 doc for review. Tagging Legal + CS-Lead for approval. :eyes:
Legal: Reviewing now. Two redactions requested in technical appendix (stack trace snippet + internal hostnames).
Ivy: Removed flagged lines and replaced with high-level descriptions. Republishing.
Sam: Excellent. Once Legal signs, OpsBot publish statuspage and CS send customer emails. We'll add reminders in #incident-owners at T+7d and T+30d for follow-ups. :white_check_mark:
Marina: Created PRD-5004 for recurrence checks and added Epic link to postmortem.
Ethan: Query attached in PRD-5004: promql snippet and link to dashboard.
Cole: Statuspage published after Legal sign-off. Live link: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1987654321
CS-Lead: Outreach emails queued, holding send until confirmation.
Sam: Closing thread  keep all deliverables tracked in PRD-5003/PRD-5004. Thanks team."
